high.title: First Bank to Raise Interest Rates Across the System in April 2026
high.summary: VietABank becomes the first bank to announce widespread deposit rate increases in April, signaling a potential tightening cycle. The bank raised rates by approximately 0.4 percentage points for terms of 6 months and longer, with online savings rates reaching 6.8%/year for 24-36 month terms. Shorter terms (1-5 months) remain unchanged at 4.7-4.75%/year. This move suggests banks are competing more aggressively for deposits amid liquidity pressures. The article notes that deposit rates had already increased broadly in March, indicating continued upward pressure on funding costs. For FX and bond traders, rising deposit rates typically signal tighter monetary conditions, potentially supporting VND and increasing government bond yields as funding costs rise across the banking system.

high.title: Vietcombank Issues Time Deposit Certificates with Rates Up to 7.9% for Amounts from 100,000 VND
high.summary: Vietcombank launched online time deposit certificates through VCB Digibank offering attractive rates of 7.5%/year (6-month term) and 7.9%/year (12-month term). These certificates have a minimum denomination of 100,000 VND and can be purchased anytime through digital banking without visiting branches. Unlike regular time deposits, these certificates cannot be redeemed early but can be sold back to VCBS (Vietcombank Securities). This innovation represents a significant development in Vietnam's deposit market, with rates substantially higher than traditional savings accounts, indicating intensifying competition for deposits and potential funding pressures in the banking sector.

medium.title: Foreign Investors Net Sell Over 1,000 Billion VND of One Billionaire's Stock in Week 30/3-3/4
medium.summary: VN-Index gained 0.67% to close at 1,684.04 points for the week, but foreign investors were net sellers of 1,025 billion VND across the market. VHM (Vinhomes) faced the heaviest selling pressure from foreign investors, while MSN led net buying with 432 billion VND. The banking and real estate sectors continued to drive market movements.

medium.title: One Bank's Stock Preparing to List on HoSE
medium.summary: HoSE has accepted the listing application for nearly 1.1 billion shares of VietBank (VBB), currently trading on UPCoM at around 11,600 VND/share. VietBank has been planning to list on HoSE since 2020, and management confirmed the bank now meets all financial and operational requirements for main board listing.

medium.title: First Bank to Be Established for Vietnam's International Financial Center: 3,000 Billion VND Charter Capital, Specializing in Payment and FX Services for IFC Members
medium.summary: Vietcombank plans to establish a wholly-owned subsidiary bank for Vietnam's International Financial Center (IFC) with 3,000 billion VND charter capital. The bank will focus on payment services and FX operations for IFC participants, representing a significant development in Vietnam's financial sector infrastructure and international integration.

medium.title: SJC Gold and Ring Gold Prices April 4
medium.summary: SJC gold prices remained stable around 171.5-174.5 million VND/tael, with slight increases in buying prices. Gold ring prices also held steady across major dealers, showing continued stability in Vietnam's gold market.
